formal_scope.ExtensionOrbits: Eight declarations: actual stabilizer transport in an equivariant fiber, injection and single-base-orbit surjection of actual quotient maps, their equivalence and value; odd-period fixed-point argument and no fixed orbit for a commuting fixed-point-free involution. No finiteness or faithfulness is assumed in the fiber theorem; the final odd-period premise is explicit for every acting element.
formal_scope.InvolutionCentralizers: Two reused declarations: involutions commuting inside each involution centralizer force string rank at most three for a centre-free generated group, under explicit centralizer, string, nonidentity and generation hypotheses.

written_links.UD.ExtensionOrbits: ExtensionOrbits.lean fiber_orbit_iff and fiberOrbitEquiv certify each chosen base orbit; the disjoint union over base orbits remains written.
written_links.UD.OddOrbits: odd_action_involution_no_fixed_orbit certifies the action argument; finite odd group order implies its odd-period premise by ordinary finite group theory.
written_links.Suzuki Section 3: InvolutionCentralizers.lean supplies the abstract rank obstruction; the Suzuki structural hypotheses remain retained written inputs.
